places.name: Miniatur Wunderland
places.ai_summary: The world’s largest model railway exhibition, featuring intricate miniature landscapes and cities.
places.place_tip: Book tickets online to skip the queue.

places.name: Elbphilharmonie Concert Hall
places.ai_summary: A modern architectural masterpiece offering world-class concerts and panoramic views of Hamburg.
places.place_tip: Visit the Plaza for free to enjoy the views.

places.name: Port of Hamburg
places.ai_summary: Known as the Gateway to the World, this bustling port offers boat tours and scenic views.
places.place_tip: Take a boat tour to explore the port and its surroundings.

places.name: Reeperbahn
places.ai_summary: Famous for its nightlife, this street is lined with bars, clubs, and theaters.

opening_hours.notes: Some clubs may have cover charges.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for hidden bars and clubs.

places.name: St. Michael’s Church
places.ai_summary: A stunning example of Baroque architecture, this church offers panoramic views from its tower.
places.place_tip: Climb the tower for the best views of Hamburg.

places.name: Speicherstadt Warehouse District
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site, this area is known for its stunning red-brick warehouses and canals.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot or by boat.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the history and architecture.

places.name: Planten un Blomen Park
places.ai_summary: A large park in the city center, known for its beautiful gardens, lakes, and the famous Elbe Philharmonic Hall.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the Japanese Garden and the tropical greenhouse.

attribution.title: Sonntägliche Wiese in Planten un Blomen
attribution.author: Hinnerk Haardt
attribution.description: Sonntägliche Wiese in Planten un Blomen, Hamburg.

places.name: Hamburg Rathaus (City Hall)
places.ai_summary: The stunning city hall of Hamburg, known for its impressive architecture and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available in multiple languages.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to explore the interior and learn about its history.

places.name: HafenCity
places.ai_summary: A modern urban development area with impressive architecture, shops, and restaurants by the water.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot or by bike.

places.place_tip: Visit the Elbphilharmonie and take a stroll along the waterfront.

places.name: Alster Lakes
places.ai_summary: A beautiful park area with two lakes, offering boat rentals, walking paths, and scenic views.

opening_hours.notes: Boat rentals available from April to October.

places.place_tip: Rent a paddle boat or take a walk around the lakes.

places.name: Fischmarkt (Fish Market)
places.ai_summary: A famous market selling fresh fish, seafood, and local delicacies, open every Sunday morning.

opening_hours.notes: Get there early for the best selection.

places.place_tip: Try the local fish sandwiches and other seafood delicacies.

places.name: International Maritime Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to Hamburg’s maritime history, featuring exhibits on shipbuilding, navigation, and marine art.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special exhibitions and events.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a walk around the historic Speicherstadt.

places.name: Alter Elbtunnel
places.ai_summary: An old tunnel under the Elbe River, offering a unique walking experience and great views of the river and city.
places.place_tip: Walk or cycle through the tunnel for a unique experience.

places.name: Tierpark Hagenbeck
places.ai_summary: A popular zoo and aquarium in Hamburg, known for its innovative enclosures and diverse animal species.
places.place_tip: Visit the aquarium and the petting zoo for a hands-on experience.

places.name: Rickmer Rickmers Ship Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum ship located in the port of Hamburg, offering insights into the city’s maritime history.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a walk around the historic Speicherstadt.

places.name: Blankenese Stair Quarter
places.ai_summary: A picturesque neighborhood known for its steep streets, historic houses, and stunning views of the Elbe River.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking the steep streets.

places.name: Planetarium Hamburg
places.ai_summary: A popular planetarium offering shows and exhibitions about astronomy and space science.
places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular shows.

places.ai_summary: A square dedicated to the Beatles, featuring a stage for live music and events.
places.place_tip: Enjoy live music performances in the evening.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the views.

places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions and events.
